title: V4-2: Core consensus data model for policies and INIT extension
scope: Minimal consensus data structures without policy behavior explosion: TxBody Policy variant, Account policy state, V4 INIT extension, snapshot conversion, canonical signing

digest: V4-2 implements the minimal consensus data model for policy engine runtime. The scope is intentionally bounded: we add PolicyTx as a dedicated TxBody variant (not self-transfer), extend Account with compact policy state fields (rescue_address, active_policies bitset, dormant_policies bitset, finalized flag), and introduce the V4 INIT extension for hybrid corporate metadata. Key serialization changes: TxBody gets discriminant 9 for Policy with embedded PolicyAction enum; Account gets optional rescue_address and policy bitsets; snapshot serialization is extended additively while preserving the current v2 read path. The canonical signing preimage covers all policy fields to prevent malleability. No policy evaluator logic in this slice - only data structures and deterministic (de)serialization. Minimal cosign envelope data is present for later V4-4 validation. The goal is a stable wire format that V4-3 evaluator and V4-4 emergency routing can rely on.

risks.description: Additive snapshot fields breaking old devnet state load
risks.mitigation: Keep serde defaults for new fields; new policy fields default to empty/zero on legacy load; bump snapshot version only for future breaking wire changes

risks.description: INIT extension field size limits not enforced
risks.mitigation: Add byte limit constants (owner_display_name <= 64 bytes, company_metadata_commitment = 32 bytes hash) and validation in Init tx processing

risks.description: Policy bitset size explosion if policy enum grows unbounded
risks.mitigation: Hard cap at 16 policies per account (u16 bitset); V4 only uses 5 system policies; overflow rejects with PolicyTooMany

risks.description: JSON u128 encoding inconsistency for PolicyTx.fee
risks.mitigation: Reuse #[serde(with = "crate::ser_json_u128")] pattern from Transfer; document in RFC 7

risks.description: Migration from legacy Account marks field (u128->u32) conflicts with new policy field placement
risks.mitigation: Policy fields use serde(default); de_marks_compat already handles legacy wire; new fields won't conflict

suggested_acceptance_tests: TxBody::Policy JSON roundtrip with u128 fee as decimal string
SignedTx::signing_message stable hash for PolicyTx with SetPolicy, ActivatePolicy, DeactivatePolicy variants
Account serialization roundtrip with rescue_address, active_policies=0b101, dormant_policies=0b010, finalized=true
Snapshot V2 load succeeds: v2 account without policy fields defaults to no rescue, empty policies, not finalized
Snapshot V3 save includes policy fields in wire format
InitTx with V4 extension fields roundtrips through JSON and bincode
TxBody::Policy fee_amount() returns correct fee for mempool ordering
validate_tx_shape rejects PolicyTx with target_account == sender (policy on self allowed, but not self-target confusion)
State::apply_tx_with_ctx rejects PolicyTx when target_account not initialized
TxError JSON shape for new policy errors matches RFC 14 response_class + error.code structure

notes.dependencies: Sprint V4-1 RFC freeze completed; no blockers
